title: Metropolitan Tabernacle Pulpit
author: C. H. Spurgeon
tradition_notes: Spurgeon was the Pastor of the Metropolitan Tabernacle, London (1854-1892). His theology was strongly Calvinist and shaped by the Puritan tradition. The MTP sermons span his entire ministry and are the largest single corpus of his preaching.
source_edition: The Kingdom Collective digitization (Emmett O'Donnell transcription from SpurgeonGems PDFs, HTML parsing by Benry Yip)
notes: Spurgeon died 1892 -- texts are public domain in all jurisdictions. The Kingdom Collective hosts approximately 3,000 of the 3,563 total MTP sermons. robots.txt returns 404 (no file exists on this domain). No ToS found. Site appears dormant since 2014 but pages remain live on Netlify. GitHub source repo bjcy/tcs.sc is 404 (deleted). Source URL is the only accessible version. Output split into per-chunk files (sermons-<start>-<end>.json, 100 sermons per file) to stay under GitHub's 100 MB file-size limit.
